subject: Implement implicit session creation on first thread message
description:
Add session lifecycle to `capo/memory/conversation.py`: on first message in a `(user_id, thread_id)`, insert a `sessions` row. At most one active session per `(user_id, thread_id)` (enforced by `idx_sessions_user_thread_active`).

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] On first turn for `(user_id, thread_id)`, a `sessions` row is inserted with `started_at = NOW()`, `ended_at = NULL`, `compacted_to_message_index = 0`.
- [ ] Subsequent turns reuse the active session.
- [ ] V1 imposes no implicit timeout; idle-timeout-based rotation deferred.
- [ ] Session boundary ends only via `/new` or `/clear` (slash commands wired in Phase 5).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Concurrent first-message attempts for the same thread serialize correctly via the unique partial index `idx_sessions_user_thread_active`.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: first-message path inserts exactly one session row
• Unit: subsequent messages reuse the active session
• Integration: `idx_sessions_user_thread_active` rejects a second active session for the same `(user_id, thread_id)`

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.7, 7.3, 9.1
